name: talkgo
description: Personal language Central (English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Italian, Japanese, German, Korean, Hindi, Arabic) with a guided Start, diagnostic, missions with a target date, practice sessions, numbered phrases, progress and management commands, all in the learner's native language; saves to Google Drive (native Docs and Sheets) or a local folder.

interface.shortDescription: Practice 11 languages, from English and Spanish to Japanese and Arabic, for real missions, in your own language, with progress saved in your Google Drive.
interface.longDescription: Guided first setup (Start), adaptive diagnostic, missions with a target date and real situations, practice sessions with simulations, numbered phrases for lookup ("repeat phrase 132"), pause and resume in text or voice, and verified progress per language, all in a personal folder of yours and in your native language.
